```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r token-setup}
# --- SECURITY: token now comes from your environment, not plaintext ---
# One-time setup: run `usethis::edit_r_environ()` (or open ~/.Renviron by
# hand) and add a line: NOAA_CDO_TOKEN=your_actual_token_here
# Then restart R so the new environment variable is picked up.
# Get/rotate a token at: https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/token
cdo_token <- Sys.getenv("NOAA_CDO_TOKEN")
if (identical(cdo_token, "")) {
  warning("NOAA_CDO_TOKEN is not set -- NOAA CDO calls below will fail with a 401. See comment above.")
}

api_endpoint <- "https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/api/v2/data"
```

```{r noaa-precip-function}
# Was called later in this doc but never defined -- added here.
# Single-request pull (fine for <=1000 daily records, i.e. roughly a
# ~2.7 year window at 1 record/day; a full year is well within this).
get_noaa_precip <- function(start_date, end_date, station_id, token,
                             datatype = "PRCP", units = "standard", limit = 1000) {
  resp <- GET(api_endpoint,
    add_headers(token = token),
    query = list(
      datasetid = "GHCND",
      stationid = station_id,
      startdate = start_date,
      enddate = end_date,
      datatypeid = datatype,
      units = units,
      limit = limit
    ))

  if (status_code(resp) != 200) {
    warning(paste("NOAA CDO API returned status", status_code(resp), "for", station_id))
    return(tibble(date = as.Date(character()), value = numeric()))
  }

  parsed <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  if (is.null(parsed$results) || length(parsed$results) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No results returned for", start_date, "to", end_date))
    return(tibble(date = as.Date(character()), value = numeric()))
  }

  parsed$results %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date), value = as.numeric(value)) %>%
    select(date, value)
}
```

## Comparing short storm-window snapshots

```{r plotting-2022-2026-rain-data}
monthly_data2022$event <- "2022–2023"
monthly_data2026$event <- "2025–2026"

# Align both periods on "month of study year" (Jul = 1 ... Jun = 12),
# so November 2022 lines up with November 2025 regardless of exact year.
study_month_order <- function(date_col) {
  m <- month(date_col)
  ifelse(m >= 7, m - 6, m + 6)  # Jul->1, Aug->2, ..., Dec->6, Jan->7, ..., Jun->12
}

combined_precip_monthly <- bind_rows(monthly_data2022, monthly_data2026) %>%
  mutate(study_month_num = study_month_order(month)) %>%
  mutate(study_month_label = factor(study_month_num,
                                     levels = 1:12,
                                     labels = c("Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",
                                                "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")))

monthly_precip_2022_2026 <- ggplot(combined_precip_monthly, 
                                     aes(x = study_month_label, y = monthly_total_in, fill = event)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Precipitation: 2022–2023 vs 2025–2026",
    x = "Month of Study Year",
    y = "Total Precipitation (inches)",
    fill = "Study Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

monthly_precip_2022_2026

ggsave("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\monthly_precip_2022_2026.png",
  plot = monthly_precip_2022_2026,
  width = 14,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Full-year monthly precipitation: 2022-2023 vs 2025-2026

```{r noaa-monthly-summary-2022}
station_gsom_check <- GET("https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/api/v2/stations/GHCND:USW00023272",
  add_headers(token = cdo_token),
  query = list(datasetid = "GSOM"))
status_code(station_gsom_check)
content(station_gsom_check, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

# Pull a full year of daily data
precip_full2022 <- get_noaa_precip("2022-07-01", "2023-06-30", "GHCND:USW00023272", cdo_token)

monthly_data2022 <- precip_full2022 %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(monthly_total_in = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
monthly_data2022

monthly_precip_2022_2023 <- ggplot(monthly_data2022, aes(x = month, y = monthly_total_in)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    limits = as.Date(c("2022-07-01", "2023-06-30"))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 12)) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Precipitation: July 2022 – June 2023",
    subtitle = stringr::str_wrap("Source: NOAA NCEI, San Francisco Downtown Station GHCND:USW00023272 | https://www.weather.gov/wrh/climate?wfo=mtr", width = 60),
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total Precipitation (inches)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40")
  )

monthly_precip_2022_2023

# FIX: was `plot = plot_2022`, which doesn't exist -- now saves the actual object.
ggsave("monthly_precip_2022_2023.png", plot = monthly_precip_2022_2023, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

    y = "Total Precipitation (inches)"
  ) +

ggsave("monthly_precip_2025_2026.png", plot = plot_precip_2025_2026, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

## Tidal water levels: 2022-2023 vs 2025-2026

```{r noaa-tide-function}
# Consolidated: was defined twice, identically, in the original (once per
# year). Now defined once and reused for both pulls below.
get_noaa_water_level <- function(start_date, end_date, station = "9414290") {
  api_endpoint <- "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter"
  resp <- GET(api_endpoint, query = list(
    begin_date = start_date,
    end_date = end_date,
    station = station,
    product = "water_level",
    datum = "MLLW",
    units = "english",
    time_zone = "lst_ldt",
    format = "json"
  ))
  fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$data %>%
    mutate(
      t = as.POSIXct(t, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "America/Los_Angeles"),
      v = as.numeric(v)
    ) %>%
    rename(datetime = t, water_level_ft = v) %>%
    select(datetime, water_level_ft)
}
```

```{r tides-2022}
month_starts <- seq(as.Date("2022-07-01"), as.Date("2023-06-01"), by = "month")
month_ends <- ceiling_date(month_starts, "month") - 1

tide_full2022 <- map2_dfr(month_starts, month_ends, function(start, end) {
  get_noaa_water_level(format(start, "%Y%m%d"), format(end, "%Y%m%d"))
})

monthly_tide2022 <- tide_full2022 %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(as.Date(datetime), "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    monthly_max_ft = max(water_level_ft, na.rm = TRUE),
    monthly_mean_ft = mean(water_level_ft, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tide_sf_2022 <- ggplot(monthly_tide2022, aes(x = month, y = monthly_max_ft)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkcyan") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Maximum Water Level: July 2022 – June 2023",
    subtitle = stringr::str_wrap("Source: NOAA CO-OPS, San Francisco Station 9414290 | https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/stationhome.html?id=9414290", width = 60),
    x = "Month", y = "Max Water Level (ft, MLLW)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

tide_sf_2022
ggsave("tide_sf_2022.png", plot = tide_sf_2022, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
